## 2. Core Projects & Technical Initiatives
1. **LifeHub AI (https://lifehub-ai.my.id/)**
   - **Role:** Solo Developer & Creator
   - **Description:** A modern personal productivity workspace consolidating smart notes, task management, and finance tracking in a single web interface.
   - **Tech Stack:** JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase Authentication, Progressive Web App (PWA) with offline caching.

2. **NEXUS AI OFFICE / NEXUS Kantor AI**
   - **Role:** System Concept Architect
   - **Description:** Architectural research project exploring multi-agent AI collaboration inside a shared digital workspace.
   - **Status:** Architectural concept and interactive visual prototype.

3. **IoT & Smart Microcontroller Lab**
   - **Role:** Hardware & Systems Experimenter
   - **Description:** Practical automation, sensor telemetry, and embedded system experiments utilizing Arduino, ESP32/ESP8266, and C++ firmware.
